addRemoteHint: The ID the app shows on the machine. Do not paste the password here.
clientCreatedHint2: Send the owner their dash link and login, then book the install.
clientsHint: Every business running on Octopos, with what they pay and how they are doing.
dashAddressHint: Filled in from the name. The owner opens their dash here.
dashAddressTaken: Another client already has this address.
healthHint: Made from payments, activity and installations. Computed by the server nightly and after every payment.
impersonateDone: Support session opened in a new tab
impersonateHintSafe: A time-boxed support session. The client sees a "Support is viewing" banner and the reason for as long as it lasts, and everything you do is logged under your name and theirs. Start read-only; most questions are answered by looking.
impersonateReasonPlaceholder: Ticket #, or what you are fixing
medianFirstSale: First sale on day {{days}} (median, last 90 days)
modeFull: Full access — fix settings on their behalf
noClientsHint: Try a different filter or search.
noFirstSales: No first sales in the last 90 days
noNotesHint: Notes are shared with the whole team.
noRemoteAccess: No remote access saved yet. Add the till's AnyDesk or RustDesk ID at install so support can reach it without a trip.
noSessions: Nobody has opened their dash from Helm.
notePlaceholder: What happened on the call, what they asked for, what was promised…
onboardingStalled: Behind pace — most clients are installed by day 7 and selling within a week of that.
ordersLast30Hint: {{count}} orders in total — the activity half of their health
reactivateHint: Their dash and online ordering come back immediately. Any open invoice stays open.
reasonShown: Shown to the client in their banner.
remoteAttended: Someone at the client has to accept the connection.
remoteCopied: ID copied · open {{app}} and paste it
remoteHint: Passwords are never stored in Helm — only where the team keeps them. Every connection is written to the activity log.
remoteNotePlaceholder: Turns off at night, ask the manager first…
suspendHint: Their dash shows a payment notice and online ordering stops. Tills keep selling offline so no sale is lost; everything resumes when you reactivate.
taskForEachHint: {{client}} in the title becomes each client's name. Leave the assignee empty to give each task to that client's account manager.
taskForEachTitle: Create a task for each of {{count}} clients
unattendedSet: Unattended access is set up (nobody has to accept)
